$comment: Near-black with a warm cast, chosen against the live wallpaper rather than on paper: opacity 55 was the point where depth still reads without the desktop deciding the terminal's colour. Maple Mono is rounded and warm, so a neutral grey background left it looking pasted on. No fastfetch block on purpose - this is the everyday style and it opens to a bare prompt.
description: Carbon Warm. Bold Maple Mono, smoked glass, no fetch.
